- The **broad group** delivered the most reach and a similar $2.29 per click.
- The **interest group** was the weakest ($2.83) and was under-delivering, so I paused it on Jul 27 and folded its budget into the others.
- Used your approved posts 1 and 3 across all groups; tested the generic post 2 only in the broad group.
